draft.executive_summary: This review recommends escalating account ACC-0074 to suspicious status due to a critical sanctions match. Account holder Fiyaz Aggarwal matched confirmed sanctions entry AM-0009 with a 100% name match and matching date of birth. Although TransactionPattern analysis was not run leaving evidence incomplete, the adverse media veto score mandates immediate escalation.
draft.investigation_narrative: Identity verification via Vision passed with complete agreement across Aadhaar and PAN documents and zero forgery findings. KYC records show account holder Fiyaz Aggarwal declared an annual income of ₹24,30,000 as a Software Engineer. Over 90 days, credits reached ₹4,32,625 across 17 transactions and debits reached ₹4,31,409 across 22 transactions, including 5 cash deposits totaling ₹1,81,218 and 1 cash withdrawal of ₹11,809. The KYC model was off for this run. Graph analysis identified 0 linked accounts and no risk flags. Adverse Media screening generated a 0.95 confidence score by matching the holder to confirmed sanctions entry AM-0009 (100/100 name match, DOB 2001-01-06) and adverse news entry AM-0031. TransactionPattern analysis was not run, so transaction pattern evidence remains incomplete; however, the confirmed sanctions match overrides pattern evaluation.
draft.compliance_conclusion: The positive designation match against entry AM-0009 satisfies match confirmation criteria under SANC-002. In accordance with SANC-003, mandatory reporting obligations are engaged due to the confirmed sanctions match. It is recommended that the lead analyst proceed with escalating this account and filing an STR.
